channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: The World Economy Is Becoming Wary of the U.S.
item.description: America’s position of global economic stability is starting to look shakier as the Trump administration piles on debt and doubles down on sanctions.

item.title: NPR: How are rising prices affecting you? NPR wants to know
item.description: Inflation, gasoline prices and the cost of living are top of mind in the election season. How are higher costs shaping the way you live? NPR wants to hear.

item.title: BBC News: CCTV shows last sighting of Noah Woods
item.description: Suffolk Police released CCTV of the last confirmed sighting of Noah in the park in Brantham at 14:37 BST on Tuesday.

item.title: The Guardian: Allowing AI firms to collude to ‘pace the frontier’ is a dangerous proposition
item.description: Tech CEOs banding together is an old ruse recycled from corporate America to get a pass from antitrust laws Anthropic’s Dario Amodei is not the first corporate CEO to suggest that excessive competition is driving the wor…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Why are election officials in the US preparing for chaos before midterms?
item.description: Trump lashes out at justices who rejected his federal mail ballot plan, raising questions on his next electoral moves.

item.title: Ars Technica: How chimps teach their kids tool tricks
item.description: Adults first demonstrate tool use, then hand over the implements to their infants, who copy the behavior.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Why the Postpandemic Tech Bust Sent Billionaires to Trump
item.description: Following mass layoffs in 2022 and 2023, many tech workers turned against their employers. When liberal politicians also rallied against Silicon Valley, their backers turned to Donald Trump.

item.title: WIRED Science: Why It Seems Like Great White Sharks Are Overrunning Maine
item.description: While a bunch of sharks cruising the Maine coast may seem ominous, it’s actually a sign of a conservation success story.

item.title: WIRED Business: Introducing the WIRED App
item.description: The app is the best way to read, watch, and listen to WIRED’s journalism.

item.title: The New Yorker: Mail-In Voting Survives
item.description: In an unsigned ruling, the Supreme Court demonstrated that it is willing to limit Donald Trump’s agenda.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: ‘My Sister Expects Me to Be Her Live-In Wedding Planner!’
item.description: You deserve to have your own priorities — even if they’re different from hers.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: The Largest Mansion in Manhattan Beach Is for Sale
item.description: Even in a neighborhood known for its oversize homes, neighbors protested the scale of 215 Exeter, which is now aiming to set a price record.

item.description: NOBLESVILLE, Ind. — An Indiana man has been arrested after police say he was caught dropping toys from the sky during a Dan + Shay concert in Noblesville while flying in a paraglider on the 25th anniversary of 9/11. Jon…
